design_philosophy: Minimal, premium, editorial. Generous negative space. No gradients, no colored UI accents. Pure monochrome (black, charcoal, white).

scale.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tighter font-medium leading-tight

visual_enhancers.background_texture: Subtle dotted/halftone background texture. Implement via CSS radial-gradient or SVG pattern with very low opacity (e.g., rgba(255,255,255,0.04)). Apply to body or hero wrapper.
visual_enhancers.geometry: Sharp clean lines for layout. Monolithic blocks. The specific interlocking sidebar/workspace geometry uses concave fillets (rounded inverted corners) for the active tab.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Monochrome transitions. Dark grey to lighter grey. White buttons scale down slightly on click.

logo_redesign.concept: Crisp monochrome. A heavy, geometric bracket/folder mark paired with the wordmark. SVG-able, highly visible at 28px height.
logo_redesign.svg_code: <svg width='28' height='28' viewBox='0 0 28 28' fill='none' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'><path fill-rule='evenodd' clip-rule='evenodd' d='M8 4H4V24H8V28H0V0H8V4ZM20 4H24V24H20V28H28V0H20V4Z' fill='white'/></svg>
logo_redesign.implementation: Place the SVG mark next to a 'Bracket' text span using font-display font-semibold text-lg.

layouts.navigation: Flex space-between items-center. px-6 py-4. Minimalist. Left: Logo. Right: Pricing, Sign in (ghost), Get started (white pill).
layouts.hero: Flex flex-col items-center text-center (or strongly structured left-aligned) with massive negative space (py-32). Small mono label at top, massive headline, constrained width supporting copy (max-w-2xl), white pill CTAs.
layouts.product_visual: In-browser HTML/CSS recreation. max-w-5xl mx-auto flex container rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-zinc-800. Sidebar (left, darker) and Main Workspace (right, lighter surface).
layouts.how_it_works: py-24. Top minimal label. Grid cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-8 mt-12. Each step is minimal: 01 mono numeral, thin top border (separator), text. No heavy cards.
layouts.final_cta: py-32 flex flex-col items-center text-center. Minimal mono label, big heading, text, white pill CTA.
layouts.footer: py-12 border-t border-zinc-900 flex justify-between items-center text-xs text-zinc-500 font-mono uppercase.

hero.label: PROJECT MEMORY FOR CLIENT WORK
hero.headline: Your client changed something. Bracket already knows.
hero.supporting_copy: Connect the conversations where your project happens. Bracket keeps track of scope, deliverables, requirements, decisions and deadlines — and shows you when something changes.

product_visual.instructions: Build HTML/CSS component. Left sidebar (w-64 bg-[#0a0a0a]): 'Overview' tab is active and docks into main panel. Main panel (bg-[#111111]): Title 'SaaS Dashboard Redesign', 'Updated just now'. Card: 'Needs your attention' reading 'Mobile screens requested — Sarah asked to include mobile screens in this phase.' with 'Review →' action and '+2 more'. Stats Row: 'Scope 8', 'Deliverables 4', 'Requirements 7', 'Decisions 2'. Use real DOM elements, NOT an image.

final_cta.label: YOUR PROJECT, REMEMBERED
final_cta.heading: Stop reconstructing your projects from messages.
final_cta.text: Connect your first client project and let Bracket keep the context.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: MUST strictly use ONLY Black / Charcoal / White. No blue, no purple, no gradients.
NO testimonials, NO logo walls, NO features grids. Strictly follow the 6 sections exactly as written.
The product visual must be built in HTML/Tailwind, NOT an image. Simulate the concave fillet by using before/after pseudo-elements on the active tab or clever border-radius.
Apply data-testid to all interactive elements.
Keep typography large and editorial. Avoid standard SaaS components like heavy drop-shadow cards.
Do NOT use 'Inter' font. Use 'Geist' or sans/mono.
Use generous spacing (py-24 to py-32 for sections).
Buttons should be white pill for primary, ghost/dark pill for secondary.
Never describe Bracket as an AI assistant, CRM, or PM tool. Use the exact copy verbatim.
Create the dot pattern background in CSS directly.

component_instructions.concave_fillets: To create the interlocking sidebar/workspace geometry: Active tab in sidebar should have bg-[#111111] (matching main workspace). Give it border-radius on the left. Use ::before and ::after elements absolute positioned at the top-right and bottom-right of the tab, with box-shadows that curve into the main workspace, creating a seamless 'docked' look.
